OBSERVED_FAILURE (exact evidence this session):
1. Consumer exit log at 07:0x listed 22 distinct NEW_ENVELOPE matches (2026-10-08T05-49-35Z .. 06-55-37Z).
   Only TWO were ever delivered to the agent as live re-entry (05-49-35Z, 06-01-05Z). The remaining ~20 -
   INCLUDING the architect ruling 06-43-00Z and the controller directive 06-44-05Z - were delivered only
   as one buffered batch when the process was killed. The agent therefore sat idle while the mailbox held work.
2. Hermes background watch-pattern cap: at most ~8 matched lines are delivered live; the task then silently
   degrades to notify-on-exit without any error surface. 22 matches => live delivery stopped silently.
   => 'no notification' is indistinguishable from 'no message'. This is the core defect.
3. Lane page can report a FALSE BUSY: architect lane showed generating=true for >10 min on a prompt it had
   ALREADY completed ('Latest response ... Response complete'); b3_unstick.py recovered it by focus
   (UNSTICK=RECOVERED_BY_FOCUS). A stop-flag probe alone is therefore not a sound page-state oracle.
4. Duplicate consumer: a stale poller with argv 'b3_watch.py 720 20' stayed alive 82.9 min (its own window
   should bound it) and RE-FIRED old envelopes (05-49-35Z). Stale/duplicate consumers make 'notification'
   untrustworthy as a signal of newness.

PROPOSED MECHANICAL FIXES (reuse existing tools; no new stores; no new long-lived processes):
A. ONE-SHOT CONSUMER + SUPERVISOR. Consumer lives exactly until it has DELIVERED one envelope, then EXITS;
   the exit event is the delivery signal (exit notifications are not subject to the match cap). A supervisor
   re-arms it immediately. One envelope = one exit = one guaranteed re-entry. Kills defect 1 and 2.
B. DURABLE LIVENESS PROOF. Consumer writes {pid, argv-generation hash, last_poll_utc, last_delivered_mid}
   each cycle. A turn may not end unless heartbeat freshness <= N sec AND exactly one owner with the expected
   argv-generation exists. Absent/stale/duplicate => FAIL CLOSED, never 'assume fine'. Kills defect 4.
C. PAGE-STATE ORACLE. 'Lane busy' requires BOTH the stop/generating flag AND a CHANGED assistant turn-id/tail
   across a settle window. Flag true with an unchanged tail = STUCK => bounded auto-unstick (bring-to-front),
   with STUCK_RECOVERED + before/after evidence. Kills defect 3.
D. TURN-END INVARIANT (agent side). A turn may not end unless (i) the consumer is proven live per B, and
   (ii) the mailbox has been read AFTER the last outbound. Otherwise the turn closes as RE_ENTRY_UNPROVEN and
   the supervisor re-enters. Prose 'next steps' is never a substitute for a proven live channel.
